attribution: User-provided Meshy model. Original geometry, saddle, UVs and image bytes retained; rig/weights and baked animation adapted for SagaBurst. Animation credits are recorded separately.
modifications: Every original LOD0 triangle retained exactly once across body and equipment, with unchanged source positions, normals, UVs and image bytes
Original 53-bone skeleton and inverse binds retained; continuous source-surface weights repair saddle attachments and tail base
Seven pinned production donor clips retargeted offline at 60Hz; walk/run contact phases adapted to source limb lengths with analytic IK
Independent LOD1/LOD2 simplification; lossless Meshopt compression without LOD0 quantization
Original saddle retained with source-space rider/camera sockets; equipped appearance is always shown

validation.structuralAudit: passed: independent source-face geometry/UV/normal/image equivalence and posed saddle/seam checks
validation.browserGameplay: passed public-path six-rider T4/T5 action/LOD/death and town saddle QA; see asset-report.json
validation.gpuPerformance: passed three paired LOD1/2 development samples; renderer submission is CPU timing, not GPU timing; see asset-report.json
validation.blenderPackedRoundtrip: reviewed critical run/jump/land poses; no mesh explosion
knownLimitations: Dense 4096/2048/4096 source textures retained without resampling.
A sampled run phase has 8.15mm minimum paw penetration; runtime contact verification is recorded separately.
Close underside views retain minor fur compression around the fixed original saddle; no source geometry was altered.
